# Specification

## Goal

Provide a simple user registration feature using an email address and a password.

## Context

Users need to be able to register using an email address and a password.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-001

**Source:** USER

Users can provide an email address during registration.

### FR-002

**Source:** USER

Users can provide a password during registration.

## Non-Functional Requirements

None.

## Acceptance Criteria

### AC-001

A user can register using an email address and a password.

## Edge Cases

None.

## Dependencies

None.

## Open Questions

None.

## Assumptions

None.
